project.name: PSR.ai (StepAnalyzer)
project.description: AI-native CLI wrapper for Windows Steps Recorder. Wraps PSR.exe, parses MHT/ZIP output, generates Markdown and GIF documentation, and publishes to GitHub.

architecture.style: Hybrid D - src/ layout with flat core/

module_map.cli.py: Command definitions: sa start, sa stop, sa pub
module_map.core/recorder.py: PSR.exe process control and fallback path resolver
module_map.core/parser.py: ZIP auto-detect, MHT boundary parsing, Base64-PNG extraction
module_map.core/generator.py: Markdown timeline builder and optional GIF assembler
module_map.core/publisher.py: GitHub API push and local docs output
module_map.utils/encoding.py: Charset detection - binary-mode MHT read with UTF-8-sig fallback
module_map.utils/paths.py: safe_path helper and pathlib-only path operations

key_pitfalls: Pitfall 1 - MHT files may use Windows-1252 or missing charset headers: always read in binary mode
Pitfall 2 - Pillow GIF generation is memory-heavy at full res: resize to max 1280px before assembling
Pitfall 3 - psr.exe may be absent from PATH on Windows 11: use 3-tier fallback resolver
Pitfall 4 - PSR output is a ZIP wrapping the MHT, not raw MHT: auto-unzip transparently
Pitfall 5 - Scripts/ dir often missing from PATH after pip install: print session fix on first run
constraints: Windows-only: PSR.exe is a Windows-exclusive binary
Zero em dashes in comments, docstrings, or markdown
GIF generation is opt-in only (requires Pillow extra)
All file operations must use pathlib.Path - no string path concatenation
Never commit .env, *.zip test fixtures, or tmp/ output dirs
